substantiveCommits.message: Fix Danchi LOD classifier and proxy state fidelity
Add Danchi LOD proxy fidelity contract
Enforce Danchi LOD proxy state continuity
Synchronize clothes LOD contract with upstream classifier fix

finding.summary: The parent Danchi LOD generator copied mesh/material and basic shadow/probe usage to proxies, but did not copy probeAnchor or renderer/per-material MaterialPropertyBlocks. A source renderer using an explicit probe anchor or local PBR override could therefore change reflection/light sampling, albedo, roughness, wetness or other material response at an LOD cross-fade even though the proxy mesh/material asset references were identical. The same source still contained the known generic Bracket classifier precedence defect, forcing the clothes-hardware closure to compensate after rebuild.
observedSourceEvidence: QualityBlockDanchiLodUpgrade.CreateProxyRenderer previously copied sharedMaterials, shadowCastingMode, receiveShadows, lightProbeUsage and reflectionProbeUsage but not probeAnchor or MaterialPropertyBlocks.
RetainedThroughLod previously evaluated generic 'Bracket' before 'ClothesBracket', making the medium-detail clothes-arm rule unreachable in the parent classifier.
The clothes-hardware closure contract required a downstream LOD2 promotion fallback because of that parent classifier ordering.

parentLodFix: Classify ClothesBracket as retained-through LOD2 before the generic Bracket rule and assert that any HD_ClothesBracket_* source resolves to the medium-detail tier.
Copy probeAnchor, motionVectorGenerationMode, dynamic-occlusion policy and sorting state from each physical source renderer to every generated LOD proxy.
Copy renderer-wide and per-material-index MaterialPropertyBlocks so source-local albedo/PBR/wetness/texture overrides do not disappear at cross-fade.
formalQaBehavior: QA4K_*, QATemporal_* and QAPreparedTemporal_* render targets trigger read-only pre-cull validation; no formal-camera repair is permitted.
LOD0 must equal the complete physical source-renderer set.
Every LOD1/2/3 proxy must resolve to exactly one physical source by canonical proxy name plus world position/rotation/lossy scale within 0.5 mm / 0.05 degree / 0.001 tolerances.

Proxy mesh and material references, layer/static state, shadow receive/cast state, light/reflection probe usage, probe anchor, motion-vector mode, occlusion policy and sorting state must match the source.
Renderer-wide and per-material-index MaterialPropertyBlock empty-state plus major PBR/color/texture override families are compared.
Declared LOD renderer sets must exactly match their HD_LOD1/2/3_Proxy hierarchy roots and no Renderer may be reused across levels.
If clothes support arms exist, the LOD2 count must equal the physical source count.
implementation.contractSynchronization: The clothes-drying hardware LOD closure contract now records the upstream classifier as source-fixed; explicit LOD2 promotion is retained only as a compatibility repair for persisted scenes generated before the fix.

verification.githubCompare: startHead -> 1ec18951837b0b524e2d15ad8ecc2391e9034e53 is ahead 4, behind 0; merge-base remains startHead; changed paths are UnityProject/Assets/Editor and UnityProject/Assets/QA only.
verification.apiSurfaceSanityCheck: Unity scripting documentation confirms MaterialPropertyBlock.isEmpty/GetFloat/GetColor/GetTexture, per-renderer and per-material-index Renderer.GetPropertyBlock, Renderer.probeAnchor, Renderer.motionVectorGenerationMode and Renderer.allowOcclusionWhenDynamic are supported APIs; this is not a substitute for compiling in Unity 6000.3.0f1.
failureInjectionPending: offset one declared proxy by more than 0.5 mm
swap one proxy mesh or material reference
change one proxy light/reflection probe usage or probeAnchor
clear a copied MaterialPropertyBlock while the source retains one
change proxy motion-vector, dynamic-occlusion or sorting state
place a declared proxy outside its canonical proxy root
reuse one Renderer in two LOD levels
regress generic Bracket precedence ahead of ClothesBracket and verify LOD2 closure failure

nextBlocker: A Unity 6000.3.0f1 Runner is required to compile the new proxy-state code/QA, rebuild DanchiHighDetail, execute the failure injections, and then capture native 3840x2160 frontal/oblique/grazing stills, 100% construction/material crops and sealed lod_walk_oblique temporal evidence. Stop speculative expansion when those pixels appear and score/fix the actual render before any further asset work.
